name: Nova School of Business and Economics
summary: NOVA's business and economics school on the coast at Carcavelos, near Lisbon; three bachelor's taught in English, entered via the national contest.

ib.text: EU citizens apply through Portugal's national contest: your IB grade, converted to 0–200, plus IB exams in place of Portuguese entrance exams; each exam at least 9.5 of 20 (2026 criteria).

programmes.name: Bachelor's in Economics
programmes.about: Economics taught in English over six semesters (180–195 ECTS), with electives from management, social sciences and law, or an internship. Only three first-year maths courses can optionally be taken in Portuguese.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, standing in for Portugal's Mathematics A exam (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

needs.note: Replaces the Mathematics A entrance exam (CNAES table 2026); at least 9.5 of 20

programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% maths (or maths plus one other exam); under 135 of 200 is never admitted. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: Bachelor's in Management
programmes.about: Management taught in English over six semesters (180–195 ECTS), mixing theory with real cases, with electives from economics, social sciences and law, or an internship.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, standing in for Portugal's Mathematics A exam (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

needs.note: Replaces the Mathematics A entrance exam (CNAES table 2026); at least 9.5 of 20

programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% maths (or maths plus one other exam); under 135 of 200 is never admitted. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: Bachelor's in Ocean Studies
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary ocean degree run by five NOVA schools with the universities of Algarve and Évora and the Navy's Hydrographic Institute. Taught fully in English; it opens with a field week in Faro.
programmes.ib: Maths is not required: exam pairs include Biology or Geography with English (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).
programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams (maths alone, or one of six pairs); under 135 of 200 is never admitted. 2026 criteria.

notes: The 36-point IB rule on the international-students page is for non-EU applicants; EU/EEA citizens are excluded from that route.
Placed in the first phase? You enrol online within four days (24–27 August in 2026).
Economics and Management offer a first-year Mixed Track with three maths courses in Portuguese; years two and three are English only.
